responsibility: This file implements structured printing of an entire RTL function in a machine-readable yet human-oriented form. It emits a top-level function directive with parameter RTL state, wraps instruction chains in explicit block directives annotated with incoming and outgoing CFG edges and flags, and prints additional function RTL state such as return_rtx, using the generic rtx_writer underneath. Its purpose is full-function RTL dump serialization, distinct from lower-level single-RTX or slim-print helpers.
